verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's marketing says bot management, along with DDoS protection and WAF, is built into the network and runs on every request for apps deployed there. That covers automated-traffic protection at the network layer, but only as a single glancing claim. missing for 10: evidence of an invisible or challenge-based mechanism (e.g. a non-interactive challenge widget), documentation of how a Workers developer enables or configures bot protection, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
